title: Season regression on region1 under seasonal-wildlife v5.4: the saved roster, rotation enabled, one full year; no out-of-season arrival, the unassigned control untouched, the scheduler firing at each boundary
fork: regression of the shipped tool (v5.3 both tiles, no sweep refund; v5.4 piggy-back off)

predictions.expects: zero arrivals of an assigned species outside its seasons across the year; COUGAR (unassigned) quantity moves only by DF's own spawn and return; in-season entries snap at each of the three boundaries

predictions.model: v5.3's second tile set broke the hold
predictions.expects: an out-of-season arrival carrying the block-biome tile 8,5 in its six-tuple

kill_criterion: any out-of-season arrival fails the regression; the S1 rerun of 16 September had none in 107 probes
culling: drop the replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: year
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1 end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); cfg.assign['COUGAR']=nil; cfg.allow['COUGAR']=nil; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('roster: allowed %d assigned %d thin %d applied %d; COUGAR unassigned control; rotation enabled'):format(n,a,f,act))
